title: PROPHECY - AGE ENDING

blocks.text: PROPHECY – AGE ENDING This special writing has to do with prophecy concerning the end of the age – a special depiction concerning the youth! The social conditions are alarming! We don’t have long to pray for them before they enter an immoral plight and total disaster into the world system! “Some will be saved, so this is a writing of special emphasis on prayer for the youth!” – “Alcohol, drugs, homosexualism and oral sex is prevalent among the high schools and colleges! Why are all of the sins visiting the children? It is because God sent a great visitation to the parents and nations and most are rejecting it!” Luke 19:42-44, “If thou hadst known, even thou, at least in this thy day, the things which belong unto thy peace! but now they are hid from thine eyes! because thou knewest not the time of thy visitation.” The majority turned down the move of the Lord and now lawlessness and horrible crimes are running rampant across the nations! Luke 21:22, speaking of the end, “For these be the days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled!” Also there is rising hatred against the parents unparalleled in history because of broken homes, etc. There will be division and strife coming. (Mark 13:12) – “And then shall many be offended, and shall betray one another, and shall hate one another.” (Matt. 24:10) “Even before the Tribulation there will be much rebellion in the home yet to appear!” (Luke 21:16)

“This age closes with a total blackout in sin and a sinful overthrow!” – “Because of iniquity the love of many shall wax cold, but the ones that endure to the end shall be saved!” (Matt. 24:12-13) “Jesus said the last days would transpire in debauchery and lewdness!” – “Paul predicted in the last days men would go from bad to worse and that there would be a sudden increase in violence and lawlessness among the youth! This precedes the anti-Christ!” (II Thess. 2:4, 9-11) “Along with men, women and the youth acting like brute beast!” (II Tim. 3: 1-9 – II Pet. 2:12)

“Wickedness of every description will become so common Paul said their conscience will be seared with a hot iron, and all perversion would be accepted as normal!” (I Tim.4:1-2) “Homosexualism is in the Churches and the schools among the youth! The Bible said it would purge the real Churches of this sin! Jesus has mercy for the homosexuals, but He hates the sin of it, but in His love and mercy He will forgive those who will repent and forsake their evil ways!” – “Let us take this liberty here to find out just what is going on! There are homosexual Churches, one in particular in Texas that come together they say to worship the Lord just like every other Church, even some claiming the Holy Spirit.” – “A Christian Church sent a representative to see just what they did, and here is a quote from the Magazine article!” – “Upon arriving at their convention each delegate was given a packet which included among other things two “Boy” magazines of all nude men and a list of all the “Gay” bars in Dallas. – So that the delegates could leave the evening service and go to their selected bar and connect with a lover for the night!” – “But before this in service, it said, but how they did sing and seemed to be praising the Lord with enthusiasm. It said the speaker corrupted the gospel beyond comprehension! He said they were born that way so come out of their closet and enjoy themselves and continue right on in the sin of it!” - “In other words without repentance they are mixing this sin right on into their religion just like the Bible said they would do!” It’s a sin! Lev. 18:22 – Rom. 1:26-27, “having the form of Godliness but denying the power thereof!” In Gen. 19:4-7 it revealed this condition even among the youth before destruction fell upon Sodom! – “Paul stressed the unholy condition of the juveniles would be in the forefront!”

“The FBI reports that thousands of teachers were assaulted in schools and the cost of vandalism was in the hundreds of millions. – Also Time Magazine reported that more girls are getting involved in violent crimes! The arrest of girls under 18 for serious offenses broke all records.” – “A law enforcement officer said this was the first time he had encountered young girls this tough! The teenagers of our age are taking on the character of brute beast! Concerning the drugs they are taking and the sexual type of perversion that they are doing in order to get money is practically unprintable! These same evil abominations, corruption and lawlessness caused the judgment of the great flood!” Gen. 6:11, “The earth was corrupt before God and filled with violence! The growth and spread of Sodomite conditions and perversion among the youth will bring on another catastrophe!” (Editor’s note: We are there now.)

Gen. 6:5, “Wickedness in man was great and every imagination of his heart was only evil continually” – “A combination of all of this will bring on the man of sin! (Rev. 13:15-18) who will introduce idols and some of the most vile sins of the history of the world will be promoted by his system in his name proclaiming himself god, but is a counterfeit!” – “Already the youth are involved with prostitution and pornography in vice rings for profit!” – Also an incredible amount of youths are turning to idols, cults, and drug oriented religions!” – “There is evil among all ages, but we make special mention of the young because there is a great need to do something! – “Even some of the fundamental Churches have forgotten, plus are allowing them to go on in their sins! But God has not, for time has come that judgment must first begin at the house of God concerning all nations!” (I Peter 4:17) “Jesus spoke to me that there is definitely a time limit now to turn our attention to this problem! We are also in store for a purging revival that will blow out the chaff and the good wheat seed will remain!” – Matt. 3:12, “Whose fan is in his hand, will purge and gather his wheat and burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire!” – “The abomination of idols spoken of in Matt. 24:15 is close!” – “Let’s join together in divine love and pray concerning all of these problems and expect a purging and cleansing revival to develop among these and His true believers! Time is short indeed!”
In the love and riches of the Lord Jesus,
